content:
maya: Heads-up — AE just escalated. Customer (private VPC) hit an egress allowlist block; control plane routed them to EU fallback and the routing layer automatically selected a smaller quantized model variant. Customer reported a clear quality regression.

alex: Ugh. Which policy kicked in? do we have the routing trace?

maya: Route trace excerpt: `route_id=rt-9f2; decision=region_fallback; reason=egress_blocked_by_customer_allowlist; fallback_region=eu-west-1; selected_model_variant=gpt-3.5-rl-7b-q4_0; original_model=gpt-3.5-rl-13b`

tj: Wait — I thought model variant fallback only occurs for capacity/latency SLOs, not for egress/region constraints. Looks like we fold region fallback into variant selection today.

alex: Historically the selection algo is: tier override -> region availability -> capacity -> cost heuristics. If fallback region has smaller compatible VMs, we pick a lighter quantized variant to satisfy memory/SLO. That means an egress-driven region fallback can cascade to model downgrade.

product-liz: That's a rough UX for customers on Private. They expect policy "no egress" to be a hard block, not a silent rewrite that changes model outputs. We should surface fallback reasons in the console and give explicit opt-ins for variant downgrade.

sre-echo: infra alert: customer acme-retail (tenant: acme-pvt) saw 11% drop in top-1 metric vs baseline after fallback at 2026-03-10T15:02Z. Correlated with routing decision ID rt-9f2.

maya: Proposed short-term: 1) surface "fallback_reason" and "selected_variant" on the request trace/logs and console per-request view, 2) add telemetry counter `routing.fallback.egress_to_region` and `routing.fallback.quality_regressions`, 3) change default policy: do NOT auto-downgrade model variant when fallback is triggered by tenant egress allowlist — instead fail-fast or surface a consent checkbox in console.

alex: Sounds sensible. For (3) we need an API-level flag so Dedicated/Private tenants can choose behavior: `fallback_on_egress: [fail, region_only, region_and_variant]` — default for private should be `fail`.

product-liz: Console UX: show a banner when a tenant has strict egress rules: "Requests that would cross your allowlist will be blocked. Admins can opt into regional fallback with model downgrade (may affect quality)." Add a clear link to audit logs.

tj: Implementation notes: routing-service currently computes variant choice in the same decision loop. We can short-circuit: if reason == egress_block && tenant.policy == strict -> return 403 + telemetry. Otherwise continue existing flow. Patch is small but needs careful rollout to dedicated infra.

alex: Agree. Need an integration test: simulate private tenant with allowlist that denies us-east, push requests, assert either 403 or same-model-in-other-region depending on flag. Also flag must be editable via private control-plane API/console.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: branch `routing/egress-fallback-flag` built and deployed to staging cluster rg-staging-3 at 1765432130. Tests: unit ok, integration queued.

maya: Can we canary to 5% of dedicated tenants first? We should collect `fallback_reason`, `selected_variant`, `latency_delta`, and `quality_delta` tied to eval prompts.

tj: I'll add sampling hooks in the telemetry pipeline and wire alerts for >5% quality regression post-canary.

product-liz: Also update docs/terms: private tenants must opt into cross-region routing. Legal may want the auditability.

alex: Action items — alex: add API flag + short-circuit logic (ETA 2d), tj: telemetry + canary metrics (ETA 3d), maya: coordinate with AE + PM for console copy and tenant opt-in messaging (ETA 2d), product-liz: legal/terms follow-up (ETA 4d).

maya: thanks all — will patch the AE response with a temporary mitigation (suggest they enable region-only fallback or configure fail) and follow up once we have the staging canary results. :thumbsup:
